chunks: 5711 - And another report has also been narrated regarding this:
“If you do not find an heir for him, and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, knows that you have made every effort, then give it in charity on his behalf.”

key_terms.الْجُهْدَ: earnest effort made to locate the rightful heir
key_terms.وَارِثًا: an heir entitled to inherit the estate

ai.seo_question: What should be done with an estate when no heir can be found after every effort?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal ruling for property whose rightful heir cannot be found after serious effort. If no heir is identified and one has genuinely exhausted the search, the property is to be given in charity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5711 - It has also been narrated in another report:
"If you do not find an heir for him, and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, knows that you have made every effort, then give it in charity on his behalf."
